meshy_task.text_style_prompt: Cannonback, a stylised water turtle creature. Clean painted colour blocks with no speckle, no spots and no mottling: legs, neck and head smooth deep ocean blue with simple large scale shapes; jaw, throat and belly plates warm cream-gold; shell plates smooth warm grey stone with clean moss-green patches in the cracks and thin gold trim on plate edges; the water cannons on the shell are polished weathered gold-bronze with dark inner openings; cream claws; amber eyes. Matte hand-painted look. No red, maroon or oxblood.

UVs identical to the installed model (enable_original_uv), so base_color/normal/roughness/metallic drop onto the existing rigged lod0; the retexture GLB itself has no skin/animations and is rescaled to 2.0 longest axis.
